notes.title: The Dead and the Drunk pushed to live for OSX and Linux
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Last fall we decided to make the content update "Dead and the Drunk" available to OSX and Linux users despite the content not having gone through QA testing for those specific platforms. This was done by putting the content on an open beta branch called "Experimental".

We're now happy to announce that no significant issues has been raised so we've decided to make this version the default for both OSX and Linux.

This will bring a bunch of fixes, Chinese localization (thanks to "Vargoth.Zhao" for bringing this to out attention) and the content update with the "Dead and the Drunk" campaign.

We hope that players who missed our 'experimental' branch update will now get to enjoy the updated content, and as always if you experience issues feel free to contact us either here on Steam or on our Discord server.

- The Broken Lines team

notes.title: Broken Lines - Patch v1.6.1.0
notes.content:
On Friday 18 December Broken Lines had a small update to fix the major issues that were reported to us.

[b]The changelog is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] Loading a mid-level save should now disable already run-level scripts correctly.
[*] PPSH weapons in the Assault loadout will no longer disappear when unequipped.
[*] The game will no longer receive player input when the end-level event is triggered.
[/list]

[i]Yes that is a short patch note, especially as this is the first post-launch update. It just goes to show that the Steam Playtest session was a big success and helped us to really clear up the major bugs before the main launch![/i]

notes.title: Broken Lines - The Dead and the Drunk AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings one and all![/h3]

The time has come, our first expansion, Broken Lines - The Dead and the Drunk is here! 
What's more, we have even more great news, this expansion is entirely [b]FREE[/b] and will be delivered as an update to the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/92431f50420b8b999e02668398558fc7ed489846.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Dead and the Drunk[/h3]

A bizarre new challenge awaits the surviving squad members. The mysterious fog released by the masked enemies is causing the dead to rise once again. 

Faced with such a situation, the squad is now on the edge of a meltdown. Crashlanding in an unknown country, facing off against an unknown enemy, breathing in a pestilential fog were all bad enough, but now they have to face hordes of reanimated corpses.

Luckily Izkor is on hand to help keep the squad together. How does he do that? With plenty of strong booze that will put hairs on your chest and then burn it off!

The masked enemies are giving no quarter and will continue to hunt you.
The zombies will attack the living, no matter who they are.

What are you left with? A three-way stand-off against an insane living foe and the mindless dead. 

[previewyoutube=7qKF0swVbNs;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/fc11269959d5bc9e2150e6b8c22347be157bf4ad.png[/img]

[h3]Fun Facts about the Playtest[/h3]

With the launch here, it's only logical for the playtest session to come to an end. We really enjoyed using Steam Playtest and want to thank everyone who took part as your help has been amazingly useful.

Thanks to you all, we were able to identify some major issues and fix them before the full launch, something that we're sure you will all appreciate.

What's more, the statistics from the playtest session beat all of our expectations.

[list]
[*] In total, we approved over 260 people (more than we expected).
[*] The average playtime was 2h 2m
[*] A significantly large proportion of the players played for over 3 hours
[*] Most surprisingly, 10% of the players played for over 5 hours
[*] The longest playtime recorded was an amazing 20h.
[/list]

What does this mean for you? Simple, the playtime of Broken Lines has now been significantly increased, and we hope that you will enjoy playing this new and bizarrely fun campaign!

notes.title: Broken Lines - The Dead and the Drunk Game Changes [Patchnotes]
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The game will now auto save every time a planning phase starts. In cases where this is blocked a message will show how long ago the game was last saved.
[*]Mortar strike and LMG has been added to Izkor's shop.
[*]Rifle rounds can now penetrate targets, allowing them to take down several enemies if they line up.
[*]Shotguns now deal AOE damage, allowing them to take down several enemies if they clump up.
[*]Submachineguns have had their firing rate and volley delays rebalanced, meaning that they should now have fewer 'awkward pauses' in firefights.
[*]Panicking characters should now be more stationary and will not run into the open or towards enemy positions as often as before.
[*]Soldiers can now be ordered to move while panicking, however, shooting and abilities are still locked.
[*]Soldiers can now be ordered to go where another soldier is currently standing.
[*]Enemies now have an 'active' vision range and a slightly shorter 'passive' vision range; allowing you to prepare after spotting an enemy before the enemy engages you.
[*]There's now a small delay between ending an event and being able to start the execution turn. Now you can spam away that starting event all you want.
[*]Target lines will now show their accuracy at the target instead of halfway between the shooter and the target. This should result in less cluttering of the accuracy percentages when fighting several enemies.
[*]Projectile path predictions should no longer report false positives, ie. rockets and rifle grenades should no longer detonate on the cover right in front of a soldier, provided that a clear firing line was shown.
[*]Weapon DPS stats will now include the reload time in their calculations, giving a more precise measurement of the actual DPS.
[*]A flare now shows the area that it will reveal when selecting a target location.
[*]Toggling the UI will now also remove all of the in-level UI elements for nicer screenshots.
[*]Difficulty settings are now stored per save slot instead of being stored globally.
[/list]

notes.title: Broken Lines - 2 Month Anniversary Special
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to a special Broken Lines news blast!

Today marks our two month anniversary since the launch of Broken Lines and we thought that it would be a great opportunity to look over what has been going on since then and give a special thank you to everyone in our community.

[h2]A Look at the Launch[/h2]
The best way to describe our emotions when we launched the game would be excitement. Afterall, Broken Lines was originally announced back in 2017! Though we stayed true to our vision of the game, the game looked VERY different back then. 

Don't believe us? Take a look at this early screenshot of Broken Lines from back in 2017.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/94f7c52c94f9174a357977c63d2aa016ae6e006f.jpg[/img]

[i]If you want to learn more about what the game used to look like, check out our first [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/broken-lines/news/introducing-broken-lines]IndieDB article[/url].[/i]

So, when launch day finally came around on February 25th, 2020, it was the cumulation of around 3 and a half years of development and we could not wait to see the reaction to the game. 

Ultimately, we were overjoyed to see that the reaction that we got was fantastic and we had a great time engaging with everyone. 

One of the surprise highlights of the launch was the reaction to our developer livestream. Did you know that originally we only planned to do a dev stream on launch day, and then leave it at that? But after seeing your reaction to our devs while they were live, we knew that we had to do a few more!

This gives us a nice moment to thank all of the content creators that covered Broken Lines, from livestreamers, to article writers, to video creators, and anyone else that we missed, thank you for covering our game. We did our best to watch/read as many as we could, and really enjoyed your reactions, commentary, and feedback.

[h2]Post Launch[/h2]
Just because the game launched, it didn't mean that we could rest. Quite the contrary actually, with all of you playing the game we had a lot of feedback to sort through, and (thankfully only a few) a few bugs to fix as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/87a475ce8acc933013a47df691af5ac925c6eab5.png[/img]

Two special highlights from the post-launch period were:
[list]
[*] Noticing that macOS and Linux gamers really appreciated having native versions of the game to play.
[*] Getting a great amount of feedback when we asked you (the community) what you wanted to us to work on in the future - the feedback poll had almost 200 replies and helped give us a direction that we knew would be appreciated. 
[/list]

[h2]Major Updates and the Switch[/h2]
This all nicely leads us to the here and now. Thanks to the feedback that you gave us in our first community poll, we decided that the best course of action to take would be to work on letting you customize the game - so that was exactly what we did. 

Though originally we did want to provide you with full steam modding support, due to some technical limitations that were not realistic (we'd have to essentially re-code the game). So we did the next best thing and open up the entire game databases. This update gave you the power to change pretty much anything, from the behavior of the enemies to the balancing/power of the weapons to simple cosmetics like re-naming the characters.

What's more, with the update we also finalized and released the Chinese translations of the game. This was made specially for our Chinese players and we really hope that they are now able to fully enjoy Broken Lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/430f0f284a6afa70639ba092459b472a39ec5ab3.png[/img]

Three days after the customization update, we hit another major milestone and finally released the Nintendo Switch version of Broken Lines! 

So, if you're a big fan of Broken Lines and wanted to play the game on the go (or perhaps we should say, on the WeGo), you can now do it. 



[h2]Looking to the Future[/h2]
Now that we're all caught up, it's time to look to the future.
Once again, we want to ask YOU (the community) for your input on what you'd like us to work on - and we're also curious to know what you think of the new customization options.

So, please do consider replying to our feedback poll here: https://forms.gle/BFfYWFfR5f6WtrUz7
And of course, you're always welcome to leave a message on the Steam discussion boards, at any of our Social Media accounts, or over on our [url=http://discord.gg/AvkDwuU]Discord Server[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/a3ad2803ef75498b1295fe9c5d50d2309a13a7c7.jpg[/img]

So, that's it for this news blast - ultimately what we want to say is a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone in our community, who reviewed the game, who played the game.

notes.title: Broken Lines Content Update - Customization
notes.content:
[b]Good news everyone,[/b]

The first major Broken Lines update is here, bringing you the ability to customize your game the way that you see fit. What's more, we've also worked on the balancing from our end, fixed a handful of bugs, and added in the Chinese (Simplified) translation of the game!

To learn what we've changed, added, and fixed, please see the update patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/926580/partnerevents/view/3336547284120434882]this post[/url].

[h3]The Request[/h3]
Since the launch of our game, one of the most popular requests has been for us to allow you (our players) to customize your game by letting you name the characters, change the power of the weapons, and so on.

At first, we did explore adding in full modding support, however, due to technical limitations (we’d have to essentially re-code the entire game) that was not possible. So we went with the next best thing - letting you edit the game databases (via the XML files) to put in custom values for, well just about anything! 

Special thanks goes out to our devs who were porting the game to the Nintendo Switch for finding this solution.

[h3]Customization - What is it?[/h3]
We weren't kidding when we said that you could customize just about anything. As the XML files are not hidden/obfuscated in any way, you will now be able to change the core values and names for:

[list]
[*] [b]Weapons and Items[/b] 
[i]Name, Price, Type, Usage, All Stats.[/i]

[*] [b]Soldiers[/b]
[i]Name, Portrait, All Stats, Starting Traits and Hidden Traits.[/i]

[*] [b]Enemies[/b]
[i]Name, AI Type, Weapons, Extra Equipment, Abilities, All Stats[/i]

[*] [b]Abilities, Traits, and Status Effects[/b]
[i]Usage count, Type, Duration, All Stats[/i]

[*] [b]Campaign Structure[/b]
[i]Starting rooster, Starting inventory, Abilities and Resources, When the shop appears, Random events, Accessible levels.[/i]

[*] [b]Shop[/b]
[i]Content and price multiplier of different categories[/i]

[*] [b]Events[/b]
[i]Content of all events[/i]

[*] [b]Levels[/b]
[i]Name, Description, Texts, Composure loss on retry, Level Evaluation, Level Rewards, Abilities awarded on completion.[/i]

[*] [b]Texts[/b]
[i]All text in the game including UI text, item and ability description, event texts, soldier comments, and so on.[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Important Information[/h3]
Customizing the game will be fun, however, there are a few things that you need to be aware of.

[olist]
[*] When customizing the game, you will not be able to unlock any new achievements.
[*] Customization overwrites the game’s normal files. Therefore, we recommend that you back up all files before changing anything.
[*] In case something really goes wrong, you can reset everything back to normal by using the “verify your local cache” option from steam.
[*] Customizing the game may potentially create bugs, especially if you change ‘too much”. 

An example of this would be if you change specific events that take place within a level. This may result in the game getting stuck if the level progression depends on a character being present/alive. 

[*] Please note that though we will try to help with any potential bugs, there may be situations where we cannot help you due to bugs that arise from your specific customizations. 
[/olist]

So, do you want to learn how to customize your game? Check out our guide [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2063665338]here[/url].

We hope that you will enjoy this update and we cannot wait to see what sort of customizations you will add to the game!

- Your Broken Lines Team!

notes.title: Broken Lines v1.0.3 Patchnotes
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chinese Localization has been added to the game
[*] Suppression will now be better explained in the bootcamps
[*] Customization support has been added to the game
[*] All of our databases have been opened up for editing - making it possible to customize the game
[*] Supplies in Izkors shop will now always cost the same
[*] Most of the bolt-action rifles have had their accuracy and damage slightly  improved
[*] (Mauser 98 and Mosin-Nagant, both non-scoped and scoped variants)
[*] Shadows in all of the levels have been rebaked to fix various lighting issues and improve the visual quality
[*] Checkpoint loading time has been reduced
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Characters would sometimes get stuck in/behind cover
[*] Knocked down characters sometimes had their target icons positioned weirdly
[*] Certain types of cover would not display the correct destruction particles when destroyed
[*] Russian players would not be able to load certain levels
[*] Walls in Strength/Mischief (levels) could be fired through
[*] Controller focus could be lost when ending a level while opening the combat log
[*] Certain tooltip labels were not localized correctly
[*] "Checkpoint reached text" is now localized correctly
[*] Certain levels would not complete correctly if too many soldiers had died
[*] Ability targetting would sometimes glitch out when used inside houses
[*] Some objects would flicker slightly when zooming in and out
[*] Scrolling in the combat log would zoom the game view
[*] ToggleUI would show as "Label" in the keybind settings
[*] Hailey's death event would not trigger due to strict event requirements
[*] Some empty/mixed up tooltips texts have been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Broken Lines on macOS and Linux
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/87a475ce8acc933013a47df691af5ac925c6eab5.png[/img]
Attention Broken Lines community,

It has been brought to our attention that there is quite a lot of interest in Broken Lines coming from macOS and Linux gamers; we regularly get asked if we 'plan' to support these Operating Systems.  

The answer may surprise you - [b]we already do.[/b]
[i]Though it may have flown under the radar a bit![/i]

If you happen to be a Tux fan, or simply prefer the feel of macOS, we've got you covered with native ports of the game.

In all, we support the following Operating Systems:
[list]
[*]Windows (Windows 7 or higher)
[*]Linux (any 64bit distro)
[*]macOS (OSX version 10.13.6 +)
[/list]

So, there you have it. We hope that you'll enjoy playing Broken Lines - no matter what OS you are on!

- Your Broken Lines Team

notes.title: A Message from our Game Director and Producer - Hans von Knut
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings all Broken Lines players![/h2]

With the latest [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/926580/announcements/detail/1720877022025589733]Patch “v1.0.2”[/url] now named The Gleeful Garand the Broken Lines excitement train keeps on rolling. Please do check out the Patch Notes as we have added several new features, fixed the balancing in key areas, and of-course fixed the most troublesome bugs.

If you have already checked out the Patch Notes, we've got two special messages for you!
[list]
[*] First, the Game Director and Producer of Broken Lines, Hans Von Knut, has a message for you all!
[*] Second, today at 15:00 CET we will once again be streaming on [url=http://bit.ly/broken-lines-steam]Steam[/url], [url=http://bit.ly/broken-lines_youtube]YouTube[/url] and [url=http://bit.ly/BLTwitch]Twitch[/url]! This is your chance to get a live response to any and all questions that you may have!
[/list]

[h3]A Message from the Broken Lines Game Director and Producer[/h3]
[quote=Hans von Knut]
Hello all you Broken Lines players!

We want to do our best to make the gameplay experience the best that we can for all of you so I want to explain how we work on the Patches!

To make sure that we prioritise what needs to be worked on in the best way possible, we have been following all the the Steam forum discussions, the Discord Channel, our Facebook, Twitter, the various gaming site reviews and of-course the many Youtube comments about the game as closely as possible. This is simply so that we can figure out what has bothered you the most. 

So we are proud to have just launched the first major patch since the launch of the game - a patch that has been created for you!

The patch focuses on several issues, most importantly:

We have increased the number of viable builds for your squad which allows you to focus on the direction much earlier on in the campaign. This includes rebalancing the content of the shop and buffing the semi-automatic rifles along with some of the less frequently used abilities.

We also heard a lot of comments about the behaviour of all soldiers (yours and the enemies) so we have made them “smarter” when panicking. This results in a slight nerf to the effect of suppression in general, thus making you a bit less dependent on SMG’s.

The way that we communicated the story and goals during the levels also led to some questions so we improved a lot of the placement, timing and prerequisites of events and win-conditions in levels.

Finally we come to the bug fixes. 
We’ve heard your cries of pain, so after looking through all of the reports (thank you to everyone that reported the bugs) we have put a huge effort into removing some of the most bothersome bugs. Floaty animations when in panic, geometry issues and visual “ugliness” in some levels, some “soft blocks” that forced levels to be reloaded are just some of the bugs that we fixed!

Of-course, that is not all - we are already starting work on the next patch. So if there is anything you are missing, then please write it in the discussion. We will keep digesting all the feedback and work hard on making the game as good as possible, for all of you.

Thank you for your time - and have a good weekend with Broken Lines![/quote]

notes.title: Broken Lines Update v1.0.2 "The Gleeful Garand"
notes.content:
The second update for Broken Lines is going to be released today, so here are the patch notes.

Please note that saved games with in-level checkpoints may reset to the beginning of the level (no composure cost though). This is unfortunately necessary and we apologize for the inconvenience.



[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A UI size option has been added to the game settings menu and can be used to toggle between default and large UI
[i]Please note: The big UI may not play well with 4:3 resolutions - all other resolutions should be just fine.[/i]
[*] The difficulty selection box now has  a 'custom' option which will open the settings allowing the player to customize the difficulty, once this window is closed the game will start the game.

[*] Rotating the camera when looking over the edge of a map into the void will no longer cause chaos with the camera

[*] 'Wounded' state is no longer incorrectly removed when loading a checkpoint
[*] Button prompt for mission outro 'continue' button should now position correctly
[*] Increased animation speed for the panic run animation
[*] Events should now trigger correctly at the "Greed" entrance
[*] The gate should now open correctly in "Retribution"
[*] The antenna box in "Contact" should now be more noticable
[*] The roof on the big building at the end of uncertainty should now once more be grenade proof
[*] Settings menu should reset settings correctly now when exiting without saving
[*] Pacifist Ability now correctly shows the accuracy reduction
[*] Covered Ability should now show up in your inventory after "Greed"
[*] Several levels have been tweaked in regards to colliders and nav-mesh.
[/list]

[h1]Controller Specific[/h1]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] End level box can now be minimized
[*] Soldiers can now be selected for the squad from the customize menu
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Selection focus should no longer be lost when pressing 'up' on the pre-campfire night scene
[*] Equipment stats should no longer show over the character biography
[/list]

notes.content:
The first Broken Lines hotfix patch has been released today.

[b]This patch fixes an issue with the controllers that caused the cursor to lock in the center of the screen.[/b]

We will continue to watch the discussions section and are making notes of all other bugs that are reported. 

If you do encounter a bug, as well as reporting what it is/what it does, please can you find a way to add your game's output log to your description. 

[b]Suggestions on how to do so:[/b]
[list]
[*] Simply copy and paste the content of the output_log.txt file in your reply
[*] Upload it to a file hosting site (e.g. google drive) and put a link to it in your message
[*] Or send it to us in a DM on [url=https://twitter.com/BrokenLinesgame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/brokenlinesgame]Facebook[/url]
[/list]
The output log file can be found in this directory:
\Users\<yourusername>\AppData\LocalLow\PortaPlay\Broken Lines 

Thank you very much,
The Broken Lines Team

notes.title: Broken Lines - Making our way to the Press
notes.content:
Our weekly news blast is back, bringing you all the latest from the world of Broken Lines!

[h1]Broken Lines Tip of the Week[/h1]
Did you know that if you play Broken Lines in specific difficulty modes, permadeath is a feature that you will have to watch out for?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/b6947a181874df51a1373a0616fb89f99fc9ec23.jpg[/img]

We have three different difficulty modes: easy, normal, and hard. If you play normal and hard mode, permadeath is enabled.

In normal mode, every unit can be revived once per game day, the first time that they go down they can be revived, however, the second time will result in a permanent death

if they die a second time, then you’ve lost that unit for good.

Can you guess what hard mode means? If you guessed that it means one death results in permadeath, then you’re right!

Do keep in mind that this is not the only way to lose units, if you’re not careful, the decisions made in-game can cause them to desert. We’ll have more on that next week!

[h1]Broken Lines in the Media[/h1]
Development on Broken Lines has been going very smoothly and we’re on track to release the game in Q1 of 2020. 

As we are getting closer to our release, we (PortaPlay and Super.com) are starting to work with several well-known gaming sites to get the hype train rolling

Are you interested in what is being written about us? Check out some of these highlights!

notes.title: Broken Lines - Winning Awards in Korea
notes.content:
Our weekly news blast is back, bringing you all the latest from the world of Broken Lines!


[h1]Broken Lines wins the Big Indie Pitch at G-Star in Korea![/h1]
We’ve got some fantastic news for fans of Broken Lines. Right now we are at G-Star in Korea, one of the largest gaming conferences in Asia, showcasing Broken Lines to the event (with over 100,000 people in attendance), and what’s more, we won the grand prize - The Big Indie PC Pitch!

It is a great feeling to get this type of recognition for our baby - the story-driven tactical game, Broken Lines!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/4e2720ce9e93e384cb9d3e6a3dbef8ff42047099.jpg[/img]

[h1]Broken Lines Community and Beta[/h1]
We are looking for beta testers to play through the game, find bugs and tell us what you feel needs improving.

[h1]Game Development Fun[/h1]
This week we’ve got quite a bit of news from the world of Broken Lines game development, so sit tight!

[h1]From Sandbox to the Prototype[/h1]
In the last month, we shared a few photos and slideshows from our very early days, showing you how we used an unconventional method to design Broken Lines - by playing in a special sandbox. 

Well, did you know that we took the sandbox created map design, and created an actual in-game version of it for our early game prototype?

The machine gunner was just as deadly in-game as it was in our sandbox!

[previewyoutube=EsSX1WoTU18;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Beta Bug Fun[/h1]
As you may have noticed, we do enjoy sharing the various bugs that we find in our closed beta, mainly because they’re usually very funny to look at. Naturally, we quickly find the source of the bug and fix it, so no need to worry about the final release!

This week’s bug was some strange behavior when it came to pathfinding. Instead of walking to one point, the squad members would continue to walk around in circles, as if they were looking for someone in the grass!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/dd32b535e428a27b55cc2e8815a4091ed4f2fcba.gif[/img]

notes.title: Broken Lines - The Importance of Cover
notes.content:
Our weekly news blast is back, bringing you all the latest from the world of Broken Lines!

[h1]The Fourth Dev Diary[/h1]
The fourth installment of the Broken Lines Dev Diaries is here. This time we’re taking an in-depth look at the cover mechanics implemented in Broken Lines. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/da88221afe5db093fb8f70216b79c1bbb9cf298e.jpg[/img]

If you are familiar with the Tactical RPG genre you may already know about the importance of using cover to your advantage; our game is no exception as cover will dictate the hit rate for both you and your opponent.
 
So sit back and enjoy learning how cover works in Broken Lines.
 
[previewyoutube=2y-STk9ewHY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]A New Website[/h1]
As we get closer to our release date (still scheduled for Q1 of 2020) we decided that it’s time for our homepage to get a big rework! So, introducing the new [url=https://brokenlinesgame.com/]Broken Lines homepage[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/6dfeb5f4ca5ce0a439613a55b2a7dae61b116e22.png[/img]

Starting things off we’ve got another fun bug that our game testers found. Somehow Avery developed the ability to move through walls. Though we think that Avery with superpowers is a fun idea, it certainly is something that we need to fix (and fix it we shall)!

notes.title: Broken Lines Weekly News Blast - A Look at Level Design
notes.content:
Our weekly news blast is back, bringing you all the latest from the world of Broken Lines!

[h1]Before and After - Level Design[/h1]
Level design is a very interesting topic, some people assume that it’s quite easy, others know that it is harder. However, what most people do not know is the amount of work that goes into creating a single level. 

We’ve got a quick before and after image for you to check out that shows this point. The before image was taken before the level artists got their hands on the scene, the after shows how things looked after they did their magic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/6e8fe4399722edb9518f49fa5ea190ec3ef99cb7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Voice Acting with Cissy Jones[/h1]
Continuing with our look on the Voice Acting, we’ve got the next clip taken from our recording session with Cissy Jones. 

[previewyoutube=dd88-QTjznQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Broken Lines Community and Beta[/h1]
We are looking for beta testers to play through the game, find bugs and tell us what you feel needs improving.

If you think you are up to the task, sign up [url=https://portaplay.dk/beta-tester/]here[/url] for a chance to get into the beta program!
Please note, signing up does not guarantee a beta position as the spaces are limited.

Furthermore, if you want to talk to the developers, get to know the other people playing Broken Lines, or simply want to leave more about the game, join us on [url=https://discord.gg/AvkDwuU]Discord[/url] today!

[h1]Fun with Game Development[/h1]
This week our developers have been hard at work on the game and fixing some interesting bugs.

One of the more unique bugs that we fixed this week (found by one of our beta testers) was when grenades could be made to trigger over and over again, check out this video to see it in action.

Don’t worry, the devs have found the cause of the bug and have fixed it, but we wanted to share this one with you!

[previewyoutube=XMwJjRTtmOo;full][/previewyoutube]

Our final screenshot is a still from the final version of the level that we showcased in our before and after. Eye-candy at its best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/d8d5b95d03f0e88261a4ddb3238d3e9350caf174.jpg[/img]

And that’s it for this week’s news blast, we hope that you’ve enjoyed it! If you have, please consider following us on our Social Media platforms for more Broken Lines content:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/brokenlinesgame/ 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BrokenLinesgame 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/brokenlinesgame

notes.title: Broken Lines Weekly News Blast - Working with Tux
notes.content:
Our weekly news blast is back, bringing you all the latest from the world of Broken Lines!

[h1]Broken Lines on Linux[/h1]
We’ve been asked this question quite a lot, so let’s make an official announcement!
Yes, Broken Lines will work on Linux!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/0db9fa034cdfef95afd7d62decc5068da8f4390b.png[/img]

[h1]Broken Lines Community and Beta[/h1]
We are looking for beta testers to play through the game, find bugs and tell us what you feel needs improving.

If you think you are up to the task, sign up [url=https://portaplay.dk/beta-tester/]here[/url] for a chance to get into the beta program!
Please note, signing up does not guarantee a beta position as the spaces are limited.

Furthermore, if you want to talk to the developers, get to know the other people playing Broken Lines, or simply want to leave more about the game, join us on [url=https://discord.gg/AvkDwuU]Discord[/url] today!

[h1]Voice Acting with Cissy Jones[/h1]
Continuing with our look on the Voice Acting, we’ve got the next clip taken from our recording session with Cissy Jones. 

[previewyoutube=_n_kB7m4HEk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Looking back at the original Game[/h1]
We quite enjoy looking back at our earlier work, and what Broken Lines used to look like, it really gives us a sense of accomplishment as it shows us just how far we’ve come.

Take this image, for example, it was taken very early on in the game’s development. Getting the blood to behave like a liquid was quite a challenge early on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/ba9da6fef73178f43347cb4ee39d214d4a527748.jpg[/img]

Looking to more recent images, this one was taken recently (as we test the game for bugs). A small part of us wonders if our game secretly wants that, as the bugs have a strange tendency to make our characters hug each other instead of fighting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/3807234f30877837b92a1954c77514b88ae16adb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weekly Eye Candy[/h1]
And let’s end this week’s news blast with this eye-candy screenshot. What mystery lies in this thick smog? Explore with caution!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35172116/06a2389eec55245bdb121634e4180cb358217489.png[/img]

And that’s it for this week’s news blast, we hope that you’ve enjoyed it! If you have, please consider following us on our Social Media platforms for more Broken Lines content:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/brokenlinesgame/ 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BrokenLinesgame 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/brokenlinesgame

notes.title: Broken Lines weekly digest - the 5th edition
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35172116/a1467e37f70214974315fa26885c4b0fcbfa054d.png[/img]

Welcome back everyone, to this week’s Broken Lines news blast. We’ve got a new character to reveal to you, as well as the regular fun reflection on the game’s early development.

[h1]Know your Squad[/h1]
This week we are introducing the Veteran soldier, King.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35172116/10de4643fe3cca1bf15dd6c1502a485ec0bde50a.jpg[/img]

Veteran King is a big, intimidating man from a family with a strong tradition of military service. King has a talent for manipulating people - with his meaty fists if necessary. For him, morality is a grey zone meant to be challenged.

[h1]Gamescom[/h1]
Will you be attending Gamescom 2019? We sure will be! Head on over to the Indie Corner in hall 10.2 to meet us, get some awesome swag, and try out the game!

[h1]Broken Lines Beta[/h1]
Are you interested in helping us in our quest to create Broken Lines? We are looking for beta testers to play through the game, find bugs and tell us what you feel needs improving.

If you think you are up to the task, sign up in [url=https://portaplay.dk/beta-tester/]here[/url] for a chance to get into the beta.

Please note, signing up does not guarantee a beta position as the spaces are limited.

[h1]Game Development Fun[/h1]
When you are adding models to the game, collision detection is vital as it prevents the models from walking into each other. When they are not set properly, this sort of situation becomes common.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35172116/395400d69d47e559273ba4b6f6f39173f92898d3.jpg[/img]

So that’s it for this week’s digest, we hope that you’ve enjoyed it! 

If you have, consider following us on our Social Media platforms for more Broken Lines content:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/brokenlinesgame/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BrokenLinesgame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/brokenlinesgame/

notes.title: Broken Lines News Blast - 4th Edition
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35172116/a1467e37f70214974315fa26885c4b0fcbfa054d.png[/img]

After a short break, the weekly Broken Lines news blast is back! We’ve got all your favourite segments, from squad members to development snapshots. 

But that’s not all, this week we’ve got something new - a way to get access to the Broken Lines beta.

[h1]Know your Squad[/h1]
In our last edition we highlighted the squad Medic, Hailey. If you’re interested in learning more about her, check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/926580/announcements/detail/2701515629368309487]last news blast[/url].

Now to this week's reveal, we've got Recruit Fry, the Stubborn Nerd.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35172116/2c578aa6aaebbccb138fd8290b75c22414a2de7d.jpg[/img]

The youngest in the squad and an educated combat medic, Fry has high ideals and the squad often perceives him as self righteous - and they're not far off. On top of that, he has trouble aiming when under pressure, so he prefers to stay out of the line of fire.

[h1]Gamescom[/h1]
Will you be attending Gamescom 2019? We sure will be! Head on over to the Indie Corner in hall 10.2 to meet us, get some awesome swag, and try out the game!

[h1]Broken Lines Beta[/h1]
Are you interested in helping us in our quest to create Broken Lines? We are looking for beta testers to play through the game, find bugs and tell us what you feel needs improving.

If you think you are up to the task, sign up in [url=https://portaplay.dk/beta-tester/]here[/url] for a chance to get into the beta.

[i]Please note, signing up does not guarantee a beta position as the spaces are limited.[/i]

[h1]Game Development Fun[/h1]
Finally, we continue with our popular look at some fun snaps from the game's development. 

Looking back at some of our early works made us think that we might have had an attraction to dramatic poses, as you can see in this screenshot. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35172116/bb4c5ec2e241452cd650dc0670acadd55e606ac4.png[/img]

The opponent that has just been shot seems to be practicing kung-fu fighting in his last moments.

So that’s it for this week’s digest, we hope that you’ve enjoyed it! 

If you have, consider following us on our Social Media platforms for more Broken Lines content:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/brokenlinesgame/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BrokenLinesgame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/brokenlinesgame/
